fields.value: Sr. Business Analyst – Banking BFSI Domain

citations.quote: Sr. Business Analyst – Banking BFSI Domain

fields.value: Results-oriented Banking Business Analyst with extensive experience in the BFSI sector, seeking to leverage deep domain expertise in Payments, Digital Banking, Retail Banking, and Corporate Banking to deliver innovative business solutions. Passionate about bridging business needs with technology capabilities to drive process optimization, operational efficiency, digital transformation, automation, and enhanced customer experiences in an evolving financial ecosystem. Senior Business Analyst (Banking BFSI) with 15 years of experience in Banking & Financial Services and a Certified Scrum Master (CSM). 7+ years of experience driving Agile delivery, digital transformation, and enterprise banking programs within regulated BFSI environments. Domain expertise in Payments, Digital Banking, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Cards,Digital Lending, Insurance, and Customer Onboarding. Strong understanding of Domestic and Cross-Border Payments, including payment processing, settlement, reconciliation, and transaction lifecycle management. Hands on experience of SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 (MX) messaging standards and payment modernization initiatives. Familiar with payment schemes including UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, SWIFT, SEPA & CHAPS. Experienced in Requirements Gathering, Business Process Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Gap Analysis, and Solution Delivery. Skilled in eliciting requirements through workshops, interviews, brainstorming sessions, surveys, shadowing, JAD sessions, and document analysis. Expertise in preparing BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Use Cases, Process Flows, and UML Diagrams. Proven experience conducting AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, process optimization, automation, and business transformation initiatives. Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Business, Product, Technology, QA, Vendors, and Leadership teams. Hands-on experience in UAT support, requirements traceability, defect management, and production readiness activities. Extensive experience with Core Banking platforms including Finacle, Flexcube, CRM, Retail Banking, and Corporate Banking applications. Proficient in Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools including JIRA, Confluence, Visio, and MS Office Suite. Strong expertise in Payments, BRD/FRD Development, User Stories, UAT, Agile Delivery, Process Re-engineering, and Banking Transformation Programs.
